verses.text: “Now, priests, this command is for you.

“If you refuse to listen and take this to heart, giving honor to my name, I will send a curse on you and turn your blessings into curses. In fact, I’ve already cursed them because you haven’t taken this to heart,” says the LORD of Armies.
“I will rebuke your descendants. I’ll smear the waste from your sacrifices across your faces, and you’ll be carried off with it.
“Then you’ll know I sent this command so my covenant with Levi will stand,” says the LORD of Armies.
“My covenant with him brought life and peace. I gave them to him so he would honor me. He did honor me and stood in awe of my name.
“He taught what was true; no wrong was found in his words. He walked with me in peace and integrity, and turned many people away from sin.
“A priest’s lips should guard knowledge, and people should seek instruction from him, because he is the messenger of the LORD of Armies.
“But you left the right path and made many stumble through your teaching. You broke the covenant with Levi,” says the LORD of Armies.
“So I have made you disgraced before all the people, because you haven’t followed my ways and have shown favoritism in how you apply the law.”
“Don’t we all have one Father? Didn’t one God make us? Why do we betray one another and profane the covenant our ancestors made?”
Judah has been unfaithful. Something detestable has happened in Israel and Jerusalem: Judah has defiled the sanctuary the LORD loves by marrying a woman who worships a foreign god.
May the LORD cut off from Jacob’s tents anyone who does this, whether awake or answering, including anyone who brings an offering to the LORD of Armies.
Here’s another thing you do: you cover the LORD’s altar with tears, weeping, and groaning, because he no longer accepts your offerings or welcomes them from you.
You ask, ‘Why?’ Because the LORD saw what happened between you and the wife you married when you were young. You betrayed her, even though she is your partner and wife under covenant.

Didn’t God make husband and wife one, with his Spirit still present? And what does he want from that union? Godly descendants. So guard your spirit; don’t betray the wife you married when you were young.
The LORD, the God of Israel, says he hates divorce and the violence it brings. So guard your spirit and don’t be unfaithful to your wife,” says the LORD of Armies.

You’ve worn the LORD out with your words. You ask, ‘How have we worn him out?’ By saying, ‘Anyone who does evil is good in the LORD’s eyes; he’s pleased with them,’ or asking, ‘Where is the God of justice?’”
